zh.d:
【新增】
· 图片/视频生成全面打通（多家网关驱动）
· 发送框「生成模式」（参数面板、参考图、结果卡片、花费预估与实付均可见）
· Web 端也可发起/取消生成
· 专家 agent 打通图片/视频模型
· 会话中心历史列表改版（按时间分组、新增对话模式列）
· 团队作战「导出记录」（整队作战过程导出成离线单文件 HTML）
· 会话分叉、后台任务实时进度、对话中途插话
· 1ONE CLI 会话新增累计花费指示器

【改进】
· 品牌统一为 One Work，补齐安装器/托盘图标/任务栏标识
· 13 语言全量补全翻译，新增波斯语（fa-IR）RTL 支持
· 数字与日期改为按应用语言格式化

【安全修复】
· 图片/视频生成工具此前可被诱导读写工作区之外的文件，已加边界校验
· HTML 渲染器资源内联存在的路径穿越漏洞，已修复

【修复】
· 内置浏览器 MCP 工具描述滞后于代码更新
· 专家市场与技能详情页缺失文件浏览入口
· Markdown/KaTeX 公式偶发重复渲染
· 自动更新未拦截降级安装
· 渲染进程启动失败时的重载风暴、GPU 崩溃噪音

【新增】
· 模型成本管控（成本上限、模型 allowlist、用量看板）
· 内容审计与 DLP（策略拦截理由本地化展示，成员离开企业自动清理本机策略）
· 通讯录同步与离职检测（对接飞书等 IdP，自动生成组织架构与移除流程）
· 部门预算与成本分摊
· 生成物集中账本
· 模型渠道统一下发（密钥不落地成员端）
· 备份恢复、运行时节点管理、审计日志导出

en.d:
[New]
· Image/video generation fully wired end to end (multiple gateway drivers)
· A Generation Mode in the send box (parameter panel, reference images, result cards, cost estimate and actual both visible)
· Start/cancel generation from the web client too
· Expert agents wired to image/video models
· A redesigned Session Center history list (grouped by time, new conversation-mode column)
· Team Mode transcript export (the whole run as one offline HTML file)
· Conversation forking, live background-task progress, mid-turn interjection
· A running cost indicator for 1ONE CLI sessions

[Improved]
· Branding unified as One Work across the installer, tray icon and taskbar identity
· Complete translations across all 13 languages, plus RTL support for Persian (fa-IR)
· Numbers and dates formatted against the app language

[Security fixes]
· Image/video generation tools could be steered to read or write files outside the workspace — now boundary-checked
· A path-traversal issue in the HTML renderer's resource inlining — fixed

[Fixed]
· A stale built-in browser MCP tool description
· A missing file-browser entry point in the expert marketplace and skill detail pages
· Occasional double-rendering of Markdown/KaTeX formulas
· Update checks not rejecting downgrade installs
· A renderer launch-failure reload storm and noisy GPU-crash logging

[New]
· Model cost governance (cost caps, model allowlist, usage dashboard)
· Content auditing and DLP (localized denial reasons, automatic local-policy cleanup on member departure)
· Directory sync and offboarding detection (syncs from IdPs like Feishu, drives the removal flow)
· Department budgets and cost allocation
· A centralized media ledger
· Centrally managed model channels (keys never land on member devices)
· Backup/restore, runtime node management, and audit log export
